## Logging

### Description
The internal Logging model will log it's Metrics to [Kibana](https://arc-es.tombola.com/_plugin/kibana/app/kibana#/discover?_g=(refreshInterval:(pause:!t,value:0),time:(from:now%2Fd,mode:quick,to:now%2Fd))&_a=(columns:!(_source),index:'45dce580-9523-11ea-903c-7304f3b45aa1',interval:auto,query:(language:lucene,query:''),sort:!(date_time,desc))) following the naming convention of `${GameConfig.friendlyName}:${currentSkin}` e.g. `Scratch: heroes`.

### Basic Usage
Add a call to `loggingModel.logEndGameMetrics()` at the end of a game to log the metrics for that game.

### Default Metrics

// Always Logged
- ORIENTATION: Shows the orientation of the device at the end of the game
- SOUND_PREFERENCE: Shows the value of sound in the user-prefs
- MUSIC_PREFERENCE: Shows the value of music in the user-prefs
- GAME_PREFERENCES: Shows the name and state of any additional preferences

// Set loggingModel.gameTime to log this metric
- GAME_TIME: Typically logs the time in seconds the game took to play out

// Set loggingModel.manualPlayUsed to log this metric
- MANUAL_PLAY_STYLE_USED: true if the player revealed any symbols i.e. tapping individual bubbles
// Set loggingModel.autoPlayUsed to log this metric
- AUTO_PLAY_STYLE_USED: true if the player enabled an auto play feature i.e. Pop All in Bubble

// Call loggingModel.updatePlayStyle() at least once to log these metrics
- FIRST_PLAY_STYLE: Shows the first playstyle the player used this game
- LAST_PLAY_STYLE: Shows the last playstyle the player used this game

// Set loggingModel.autoBuyPurchase to log this metric
- AUTO_BUY_PURCHASE: Shows if the game was bought with the AutoPlay feature
// Set loggingModel.swipeToBuyPurchase to log this metric
- SWIPE_TO_BUY_PURCHASE: Shows if the game was bought with the SwipeToBuy feature

// Enable the colourBlind feature to log this metric
- COLOUR_BLIND_MODE_ON: true when colourBlindMode is turned on at the end of the game

### API
`import { loggingModel } from '@arcade-client/base-package';`

#### bootstrapErrorModel.error: boolean
Set to true when any error happens during the Bootstrap process.

Typically used to disable the Cabinet preventing further errors reaching the Server.

#### loggingModel.gameTime: number | undefined
Should be set at the end of a game to something like `Number(((Date.now() - buyInTime) / 1000).toFixed(2))` to enable logging the duration time of the game.

#### loggingModel.hasViewedHTP: boolean
Used Internally to log only the first time the HTP is viewed (ignoring when it is auto displayed to new players)

#### loggingModel.swipeToBuyPurchase: boolean
Should be set to true when the game is bought into via SwipeToBuy.

#### loggingModel.autoPlayPurchase: boolean
Should be set to true when the game is bought into via AutoBuy.

#### loggingModel.manualPlayUsed: boolean
Should be set to true when the player manually interacts with any game mechanics.

#### loggingModel.autoPlayUsed: boolean
Should be set to true when the player enables any autoPlay mechanics such as PopAll in Bubble.

#### loggingModel.updatePlayStyle(newStyle: string): void
Updates the firstPlayStyle value to the passed string on first call and lastPlayStyle on any subsequent calls.

#### loggingModel.logMetrics(props: IMetricLog): void
Logs the passed items at a level of Debug1 under the name `${GameConfig.FriendlyName} Metrics` as a `game_client-metric`.

Extend IMetricLog with any additional items.

#### loggingModel.logEndGameMetrics(props?: IMetricLog): void
Logs the available endGame Metrics at a level of Debug1 under the name `${GameConfig.FriendlyName} Game Data` as a `game_client-metric` and resets the data ready for the next game.

Param props can be used to add more items to the log if required. Extend interface IMetricLog with additional items.

#### loggingModel.logException(message: string): void
Logs the passed message at a level of ERROR as a `game_client-exception`
